main_text.p: ut איש טוב ifch tób, vir bonus : si autem substantivum sequitur, subintelligenda est copula, ut יהוה רחום rachum Iehova, misericors (scilicet est) Dominus.

Excipiuntur numeralia cardinalia, quæ post unum ad decem usque adduntur pluralibus, & præponuntur substantivis, ut שבע שנים scebag schanim, septem an-ni: post decem vero usq; ad centum jun-guntur cum singularibus, ut שלושים שנה chelofchim schaná, triginta anni.

Adjectivum significans copiam, desiderium, notitiam, memoriam, metum, aut contrá, regit Substantivum nomen, quod per Genitivum vel Ablativum explicatur, ut, שבע ימים sebagjamím. fatur dierum. חסר לב chasar leb, deficiens corde.

page.notes: The Hebrew words are copied as best read from the scan; the vowel points and the final letters of the Hebrew forms are not fully certain. The catchword "r" sits below the last line at the right and is a single letter. The word "usq;" is printed with a tilde-type abbreviation mark that is taken as the -que abbreviation. The first Hebrew word after "ut" may be "טוב" as read, but the scan is small here.
